evidence.reason: Line 177 expands both `%i` and `%I` with the raw instance parsed from the unit filename. systemd defines `%i` as the escaped instance name and `%I` as its unescaped form (for example `crq\x2dtick` becomes `crq-tick`), so `%I` references are compared using the escaped name and can be dropped by the scan. The smallest compatible repair is to apply systemd unit-name unescaping only to the `%I` substitution while keeping `%i` unchanged.
